title: Forests - Vanilla Expanded
description: A mod that adds vanilla friendly forest biomes
body:
# Vanilla Expanded
Vanilla Expanded Forests is a part of the Vanilla Expanded Modpack. This mod focuses on creating two forest biomes with additional blocks, mobs, and structures. The main goal of this mod, and the modpack as a whole, is to create a vanilla friendly overworld update in the style of an offical mojang update.

## Biome
- Fir Forest
- Chestnut Grove
## Blocks
- Full fir wood set
- Full chestnut wood set
- Crate
## Mobs
- Raccoon
## Structure
- Campsite
